title: The Gallows Bargain
text: A condemned grave-robber, rope already round his neck, shouts to the crowd that he knows where the Founder's sword is buried, and he will tell the first House that buys his pardon. The hangman is waiting. So is the crowd.

outcomes.text: He leads you to an unmarked grave outside the walls. The sword is there, wrapped in a shroud. So is the Founder, who is not as dead as the histories say.
He leads you to the grave, points, and runs. The grave is empty, and fresh. He is never seen again, and neither is your gold.

options.label: Take him into your service instead of paying.

outcomes.text: The magistrates hand him over in chains. He is quick, clever and loyal for exactly as long as it suits him, and he never tells you where the sword is.

options.label: Let the hangman do his work.

outcomes.text: He hangs. His last words are a set of directions, and nobody is quite sure afterwards whether they wrote them down right.
